scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-setu --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-setu "npm run test:rules -w scripts"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-setu "npm run test:functions -w scripts"
